rationale: Roseburia intestinalis is a lactate/glucose fermenter producing butyrate and acetate. Lactate and glucose remain abundant (27.31 and 24.18 mM). Continuing established high-rate co-fermentation (10 mmol lactate, 8 mmol glucose per gDW/h) with 0.37 /h growth is sustainable for 4 more hours given ammonium availability (8.948 mM supports ~2 h at 4 mmol/gDW/h). Carbon balance: 18 mmol C in − 14.06 mmol C biomass = 3.94 mmol C for fermentation products, consistent with butyrate/acetate/CO₂/formate stoichiometry in lactate fermentation.
